items.name: use-current-user
items.title: useCurrentUser
items.description: Typed hook that returns the current authenticated user via React Query. Reads from the Better Auth session endpoint by default; configurable.

items.name: role-gate
items.title: RoleGate
items.description: Client-side gate that renders its children only when the current user's role is in an allowed set. Pairs with useCurrentUser.
